subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When a task assessment is complete, the planning system shall derive `capability`, `deliberation`, `context`, and `assurance` minimums from the normative execution-profile vocabulary by a versioned max-of-floors policy plus named interaction promotions.
rationale: independent requirements avoid false scalar precision
fit_criterion: every derivation golden produces only accepted values plus the applicable policy version; no input is reduced by another input
